ranked.headline: Computational inference of tissue spatial organization from spatial transcriptomic data
ranked.summary: Recent preprints add neighborhood-aware spatial inference methods and a 21-dataset benchmark for post-GWAS cell-trait mapping.

ranked.headline: Learned protein and peptide representations are applied to binding and design tasks
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications directly compare embedding choices and generate peptide and capsid sequences from protein language model features.

ranked.headline: Injecting biological structure into sequence models for genomic and protein prediction
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications apply tokenization, k-mer, taxonomy, and structure-aware designs to sequence-based prediction across genomes and proteins.

ranked.headline: Ligand format and charge state affect co-folding protein-ligand predictions
ranked.summary: Representation choices, from QM descriptors to ligand input format, now shape the reliability of ML ligand property and interaction predictions.

ranked.headline: Sequence-based models infer splicing, cleavage, and organellar protein membership
ranked.summary: Learned sequence representations now predict context-dependent splicing, piRNA cleavage, and mitochondrial protein membership from indirect data.

ranked.headline: Biological structure encoded in inference for single-cell and spatial tumor profiling
ranked.summary: Single-cell, spatial, and plasma measurements are increasingly paired with inference that encodes network, spatial, or cell-state context.

ranked.headline: Genome-wide STRs and haplotype similarity refine population structure inference
ranked.summary: Dense genome-wide variation now resolves human population structure more finely than SNPs and phases unrelated individuals across chromosomes.

ranked.headline: Hybrid and long-read inputs extend variant detection beyond short-read alignment
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers add nanopore dwelling-time, hybrid sequencing, and donor-specific assemblies to variant detection workflows.

ranked.headline: Zero-shot models fail on epistatic variants; language models track viral evolution
ranked.summary: Zero-shot benchmarks and antibody and viral evolution models now test where sequence-based prediction of variant effects holds.

ranked.headline: Cryo-EM and cryo-ET density constrain generative and regression-based atomic modeling
ranked.summary: February 2026 preprints apply diffusion, variational, and regression models to cryo-EM and cryo-ET density for atomic modeling.

ranked.headline: Single-cell models face scrutiny over evaluation validity and mechanistic content
ranked.summary: Scaling, interpretability, and perturbation benchmarks now test whether learned single-cell models deliver what their metrics suggest.

ranked.headline: Variant-level evidence extends to gene and trait inference across predictors and models
ranked.summary: Recent items test variant effect predictors across ancestries and extend prioritization to gene- and trait-level models.

ranked.headline: Read-level methods infer resistance plasmids and variants without assembly steps
ranked.summary: Recent preprints move resistance-relevant inference from raw nanopore and short-read data into end-to-end analysis tools.

ranked.headline: Inferring pathogen genotypes and abundances from indirect or mixed sequencing data
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and one published study infer pathogen resistance, variant abundance, or diversity without isolate-level sequencing.

ranked.headline: Dynamic, scale-dependent descriptors characterize functional brain network interactions
ranked.summary: Directed, time-varying, and scale-resolved analyses of neural data now test interaction structure across MEG, fMRI, LFP, and whole-cortex models.

ranked.headline: Reference data constraining protein structure and conformational ensemble models
ranked.summary: Recent work couples ion mobility, QM/MM reference, and MD conformational data directly to structure prediction and force-field parametrization.

ranked.headline: Software converts microscopy images into quantitative measurements across biological…
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers describe reusable workflows that extract quantitative measurements from tissue, cell, subcellular, and molecular imaging data.

ranked.headline: Multimodal fusion models score drug, target and peptide interactions
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications fuse heterogeneous molecular features to score drug, target and peptide interactions within one framework.

ranked.headline: Computational predictions of structure and dynamics tested against experiment
ranked.summary: Recent items explicitly benchmark learned and physics-based predictions against experimental structures, spectra, and energetics.

ranked.headline: Mechanistic models link growth, kill, and interaction structure to microbial outcomes
ranked.summary: Explicit mechanistic parameters now predict bacterial selection, community stability, and outbreak burden under treatment and resource perturbation.

ranked.headline: Sequence patterning governs peptide condensation and membrane translocation
ranked.summary: Enhanced-sampling simulations and design algorithms now quantify how sequence patterning dictates peptide phase behavior and membrane translocation.

ranked.headline: Annotation quality gates cross-lineage comparisons in nematode, insect and kelp genomes
ranked.summary: Community curation and multi-species resources converge on accurate gene models and orthology as prerequisites for reliable cross-lineage genome comparison.

ranked.headline: Coarse-grained simulations tie chemical and stoichiometric tuning to assembly mechanics
ranked.summary: Near-atomistic and coarse-grained simulations now resolve how chemistry and stoichiometry shape assembly mechanics and internal organization.

ranked.headline: Reusable tools for alignment, regulatory modelling, phenotype networks and genotype QC
ranked.summary: Recent releases package specialised genomic and regulatory analyses as standalone tools with CLI, GUI, or browser interfaces.

ranked.headline: Model-based inference of host, gene, and community traits from microbiome sequencing
ranked.summary: Recent work applies likelihood, mechanistic, and multi-omics models to extract host sex, gene bimodality, and engraftment from metagenomes.

ranked.headline: Causal and constraint-based inference prioritizes aging and liver disease targets
ranked.summary: Public transcriptomic and multi-omic resources now support causal and metabolic-model inference for prioritizing targets in aging and liver disease.

ranked.headline: Pathogen genome assemblies from natural infections and multi-strain RBP comparisons
ranked.summary: Direct assembly from natural-infection blood and multi-strain regulatory gene comparisons are expanding eukaryotic pathogen genome resources.

ranked.headline: Benchmarks expose limits of multimodal models for patient survival and drug response
ranked.summary: Multimodal and transfer-learning models for cancer prediction are now judged against downstream clinical and biological readouts, not architecture alone.

ranked.headline: Standardized ontologies and AI tools structure reproducible biological data analysis
ranked.summary: Open-weight LLMs, ML formula assignment and genomic model benchmarking now target reproducibility and interoperability of biological datasets.

ranked.headline: Explicit mechanical models link subcellular forces to tissue-scale outcomes
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published simulation treat force transmission explicitly, from junction adhesion to epithelial stratification.

ranked.headline: Recovering glycopeptides and DIA peptides beyond standard tryptic database searches
ranked.summary: Open-source DIA tools and glycan-derived mass offset searches expand peptide identification from existing mass spectrometry data.

ranked.headline: MD simulations resolve protonation- and lipid-dependent membrane interactions
ranked.summary: Long-timescale and all-atom MD now resolve protonation-state and membrane-environment dependence of ion conduction and antibiotic-membrane interactions.

ranked.headline: Minimizer-seeded partial order alignment and FPGA peptide search accelerate throughput
ranked.summary: Recent preprints report multi-fold speedups in graph and peptide search, shifting focus to memory-efficient, hardware-aware alignment design.

ranked.headline: Multimodal deep learning across gene networks, single-cell omics, and regulatory maps
ranked.summary: Foundation-model, graph, and diffusion architectures are now applied to multimodal omics and multiplex biological networks.

ranked.headline: Linking noncoding GWAS variants to target genes, 3D contacts, and conserved CpGs
ranked.summary: Recent preprints pair GWAS variants with CRISPRi screens, chromatin conformation, and TE-epigenome resources to resolve regulatory mechanisms.

ranked.headline: Geometry-aware learning models for molecular design and committor prediction
ranked.summary: Recent work applies geometric and symmetry-aware representations to molecular generation, protein design, and committor prediction.

ranked.headline: Functional classification of somatic mutations in cancer genomes
ranked.summary: Recent preprints apply regulatory, driver, repair-signature and language-model approaches to assign functional consequence to somatic mutations.

ranked.headline: Parallel and alignment-free methods scale sequence search and phylogenetic placement
ranked.summary: Four February 2026 publications target throughput limits in sequence search, structural dataset assembly and genome-wide read placement.

ranked.headline: Post-mortem artifacts and overlooked cell states confound human tissue transcriptomics
ranked.summary: Recent single-cell and post-mortem studies quantify both overlooked maintenance states and processing-induced bias in human transcriptomic data.

ranked.headline: Mutation-selection dynamics localize quasispecies and bias evolution toward flat fitness
ranked.summary: Recent preprints give analytical treatment of localization, curvature-driven bias, and fluctuation-induced power laws in evolutionary and ecological models.
